extracted.name: Cilantro Serrano Cream Sauce
extracted.description: Similar to serrano crema, this quick sauce is great for chicken tacos and fish tacos. It’s also great as a dip!
ingredient_lines: 3 serrano chile peppers, seeded and chopped
instruction_lines: Place cilantro, serrano peppers, garlic, mayonnaise, and cream into a blender; season with salt and pepper. Purée until smooth, about 15 seconds.
